outcome: Clinical and histologic severity of placenta accreta spectrum
Accurate diagnosis of dehiscence with nonadherent placenta
cohort: Pregnant individuals with anterior low-lying placenta or placenta previa with a previous caesarean section and suspicion of placenta accreta spectrum
finding: Three-dimensional volume rendering ultrasound effectively discriminates between scar dehiscence with underlying nonadherent placenta and placenta accreta spectrum and shows potential in predicting urinary bladder involvement in placenta accreta spectrum cases.
